children.text: TRADEWITHMH
is a premium trading brand website and performance tracking system built to support traders with disciplined guidance, structured trade journaling, and data-driven performance analysis.

The project includes a public-facing landing page for the trading brand, designed with a luxury dark-gold visual identity, strong hero messaging, clear call-to-action buttons, WhatsApp and Instagram links, booking flow, and access to the Trader Performance System.

Alongside the marketing website, the project includes a private trader dashboard that tracks key trading performance metrics such as total trades, win rate, total P&L, total R, average R, max drawdown, wins, losses, best trade, worst trade, profit factor, expectancy, average win, and average loss.

The performance system gives traders a clear view of their growth using visual analytics including cumulative R performance, cumulative profit and loss, setup performance, long versus short distribution, and performance by trading session.
The final experience combines brand credibility, lead generation, and internal performance analytics in one complete trading platform.

shortDescription.en: TRADEWITHMH is a premium trading brand website and trader performance system focused on risk management, execution, trade journaling, analytics, and long-term trading discipline.

children.text: Fatma Elzahraa Gold is a Cairo-based jewelry house specializing in 24K ,21K , 18K and 14K gold ingots (سبايك), rings, and bracelets. The brand needed a digital storefront that felt as considered as the jewelry itself — Arabic-first, but accessible to English readers; transparent about karat and weight; and trustworthy enough that customers in Egypt would feel confident ordering online with cash on delivery.
What I built
A complete bilingual e-commerce experience designed around one principle:
karat clarity
. Every product is presented with its karat, weight, and live price calculated against the day's rate per gram — the same way a customer would expect at the counter on Al-Geish Street.
The storefront covers the full purchase journey:
Live pricing engine.

A dedicated, admin-editable page publishes daily sell/buy rates for 7 gold karats (24K through 9K) and 6 silver grades (999, 925, 900, 800, 600, ounce). Rates feed into the homepage ticker and product cards.
Three product categories.
Ingots (سبايك), Rings (خواتم), and Bracelets (اساور) — with featured collections, "new arrivals," low-stock badges, sold-out states, and discount markdowns.
Bilingual UI.
Arabic (RTL) is the default; English (LTR) is a one-click toggle. The same content surfaces in both layouts without doubled product entries.
Frictionless cart and checkout.
Cart, cash-on-delivery checkout, and a no-login order tracking page (track by ID alone).
Trust-built UI.
Quality certification badge, fast-delivery promise, cash-on-delivery, and 24/7 support are surfaced as commitments throughout.
Direct contact paths.
WhatsApp, phone, Facebook, and Google Maps location wired directly into the header and footer.

shortDescription.en: A bilingual Arabic-first online storefront for an Egyptian jewelry house, featuring live daily karat pricing for gold and silver, a full product catalog, cart, order tracking, and a mobile-first checkout designed for trust.

children.text: RA’ - Ramy Rafaat Designs

is a premium website created for a luxury interior design brand based in Cairo, Egypt. The website presents the designer’s identity, portfolio, services, design philosophy, and consultation flow through a clean and elegant digital experience.

The project was built to reflect the nature of high-end interior design: refined visuals, strong spacing, smooth presentation, luxury typography, and a portfolio-first structure that allows visitors to explore completed residential projects with clarity and confidence.

The website includes a homepage with strong brand positioning, featured portfolio projects, service sections, about page, contact form, WhatsApp call-to-action, and a full portfolio page for showcasing residential interior design projects. It was designed to convert visitors into inquiries by guiding them from visual inspiration to direct consultation.
The experience focuses on elegance, trust, and lead generation, helping the client present their work professionally and attract premium interior design customers.

shortDescription.en: RA’ - Ramy Rafaat Designs is a luxury interior design website showcasing elegant residential projects, design services, 3D visualization, space planning, and consultation requests in a premium digital experience.

tagline.en: Luxury Interior Design Website for Elegant Residential Spaces

children.text: MubarmiJ Menus
is a digital restaurant menu platform built to help restaurants replace traditional printed menus with modern, bilingual, QR-based menus.

The platform allows restaurants to create beautiful digital menus in both English and Arabic, with automatic RTL support for Arabic users. Restaurants can upload their logo, customize theme colors, add menu items with images, descriptions, prices, and manage custom item attributes such as size, spice level, extras, or add-ons.

Customers can scan a QR code from the table, browse the restaurant menu, select items, and prepare their order list before the waiter arrives — without needing to create an account. The platform also supports WhatsApp-based verification for secure restaurant login and easier password recovery.

The final result is a practical FoodTech SaaS platform that helps restaurants improve customer experience, reduce menu printing costs, simplify menu updates, and present their brand in a cleaner digital way.

shortDescription.en: MubarmiJ Menus is a bilingual digital restaurant menu platform that helps restaurants create branded QR menus, manage items, support Arabic/English, and let customers build orders easily.

children.text: MASAR GROUP

is a professional corporate website built for a company operating in the oil and gas services sector. The website presents the company’s expertise in procurement planning, project management, and the trading of oil products through a clean, credible, and business-focused digital presence.

The project was designed to support the company’s positioning as a trusted energy-sector partner by presenting its services, business profile, industry experience, and contact channels in a clear and professional way.

The website focuses on corporate credibility, service clarity, and lead generation. It helps potential clients, partners, and stakeholders quickly understand the company’s scope of work, explore its oil and gas service offerings, and contact the team for business inquiries.

The visual direction should be presented in the portfolio as a serious corporate energy website with strong structure, professional content, clear navigation, and a design style suitable for B2B oil and gas companies.

shortDescription.en: MASAR GROUP is a corporate oil and gas website presenting procurement planning, project management, petroleum trading, and energy services through a professional digital presence.

tagline.en: Leading Excellence in Oil & Gas Services

children.text: Fantazia Cruise

is a luxury tourism website built to showcase premium cruise and yacht experiences in Sharm El Sheikh. The website presents the brand’s trips, booking flow, about section, and contact details through a clean and elegant travel-focused digital experience.
The platform highlights upcoming trips such as
Liberty Carnival
Carnival
, and
Mega A Class
, giving visitors a clear way to explore available cruise experiences and move directly toward booking. The homepage uses strong luxury positioning with the message
“Enjoy a Luxury Experience”
, supported by visual cruise content and clear calls-to-action.

The website was designed to help Fantazia Cruise present its boats, promote Red Sea travel experiences, and convert visitors into inquiries through direct booking buttons and accessible contact information.
The final result is a polished tourism website that combines destination appeal, trip discovery, luxury branding, and lead generation in one responsive web experience.

shortDescription.en: Fantazia Cruise is a luxury cruise and yacht trips website for Sharm El Sheikh, showcasing upcoming boat trips, booking CTAs, premium cruise experiences, and direct contact details.

children.text: Amwally

is a modern personal finance and asset management mobile application designed to help users manage their money, track transactions, monitor assets, and understand their financial position in one clean dashboard.

The app allows users to record income and expenses, organize transactions by category, manage customers, create reminders, and track financial performance through visual reports. It also includes a powerful asset module where users can monitor gold, silver, bank accounts, other assets, and live metal prices in EGP.

The interface was designed with a clean, premium mobile-first experience using soft cards, modern icons, smooth spacing, clear financial indicators, and a calm green identity that reflects trust, growth, and financial stability.
Amwally focuses on making personal finance simple, visual, and practical for daily use.

shortDescription.en: Amwally is a personal finance mobile app for tracking income, expenses, customers, reminders, assets, gold, silver, bank accounts, and net worth with clean reports and smart financial insights.

tagline.en: Smart Personal Finance & Asset Tracking App
